verdict.rationale: Kimi's help center lists 定时任务 (scheduled tasks) among the assistant's general features, so first-party evidence shows the product has a scheduling capability. That evidence is a single help-index line with no detail on recurrence, so a one-off timed action can't be distinguished from a recurring schedule. missing for 10: explicit recurring-schedule support (cron/intervals), scope of what jobs or workflows can be scheduled, configuration documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: 搜索、记忆、定时任务、技能等通用功能
